metadata.description:
Based on the web-comic by David Revoy - https://www.peppercarrot.com/en/webcomic/ep04_Stroke-of-genius.html

Made with free/open-source software:

  • Synfig - https://gumroad.com/a/683871059
  • Krita - https://krita.org/en/download/krita-desktop/
  • Blender - https://www.blender.org/download/
  • RenderChan - https://morevnaproject.org/renderchan/

License - CC-BY-SA 4.0.

Support creating more animated episodes of Pepper&Carrot:

  • https://morevnaproject.org/pepper-and-carrot/sponsor/

Learn how to create animated videos like this - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_IcXTg4OQMU
___________________________________________________________________________________________________

Morevna Project is an experimental animation studio which adopts open-source philosophy and uses open-source software to produce animation works.

🌍 Find more on our website - https://morevnaproject.org/
